title.narrative: IFDK India Climate Finance Initiative - capital contribution

description.narrative:
IFDK General Description: Impact Fund Denmark (IFDK) is Denmark’s development finance institution, supporting sustainable private sector investments in developing countries. IFDK invests in sustainable growth and high-impact solutions, mobilising capital to tackle global challenges where the need is greatest. The focus is on investments that offer high development impact and scalable business opportunities.
Project/Instrument specific description: In 2020, Denmark and India formalised a Green Strategic Partnership to support India’s green transition and strengthen Danish engagement in the country. Under this partnership, the Danish Minister for Development Cooperation approved the India Climate Finance Initiative, a DKK 200 million earmarked capital contribution to Impact Fund Denmark. The contribution is intended to support green investments in India in areas such as renewable energy, energy efficiency, waste management, and water. It will finance relevant green projects while accepting higher risk and potentially lower returns.
Case stories: Development effects of investments projects often take years to materialize, making them difficult to capture within short reporting periods. As a result, the indicator reporting focuses on tangible outputs, such as the number of investments, as proxies, based on the assumption that these will contribute to long-term development impact. To learn more about the development effects, see the case stories on IFDK’s website, in IFDK’s Annual Report, and in the Open Aid section below.
Support green transition and sustainable development in India, and contribute to the fulfilment of the India-Denmark Green Strategic Partnership.
